notebooks.title: 水箱：估计后在另一段实验上验证
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
def tank(u, a=0.8, b=0.2, initial=0.0):
    y = np.empty(len(u) + 1)
    y[0] = initial
    for k in range(len(u)):
        y[k + 1] = a * y[k] + b * u[k]
    return y

cells.code:
u_est = np.array([1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0], dtype=float)
y_est = tank(u_est)
Phi = np.column_stack((y_est[:-1], u_est))
theta, _, rank, singular = np.linalg.lstsq(Phi, y_est[1:], rcond=None)
assert rank == 2
assert np.allclose(theta, [0.8, 0.2], atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
assert np.allclose(y_est[1:4], [0.2, 0.16, 0.328], atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
print('first_levels_cm', np.round(y_est[1:4], 6).tolist())
print('rank', rank, 'a_b', np.round(theta, 6).tolist())

u_val = np.array([0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1], dtype=float)
y_val = tank(u_val, initial=0.3)
a_hat, b_hat = theta
one_step = a_hat * y_val[:-1] + b_hat * u_val
free_run = tank(u_val, a_hat, b_hat, initial=y_val[0])
residual = y_val[1:] - one_step
rmse_prediction = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(residual ** 2)))
rmse_simulation = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y_val[1:] - free_run[1:]) ** 2)))
assert max(rmse_prediction, rmse_simulation) < 1e-12
print('validation_initial_cm', y_val[0], 'pairs', len(u_val))
print('prediction_RMSE_cm', format(rmse_prediction, '.3e'))
print('simulation_RMSE_cm', format(rmse_simulation, '.3e'))
print('validation_levels_cm', np.round(y_val, 6).tolist())

notebooks.title: 边界实验：完美拟合不能补足信息

cells.code:
Phi_flat = np.ones((8, 2))
target = np.ones(8)
minimum_norm, _, rank_flat, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(Phi_flat, target, rcond=None)
for candidate in ([0.8, 0.2], [0.5, 0.5]):
    assert np.allclose(Phi_flat @ candidate, target, atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
assert rank_flat == 1
assert np.allclose(minimum_norm, [0.5, 0.5], atol=1e-12, rtol=0)
print('steady_rank', rank_flat, 'minimum_norm', np.round(minimum_norm, 6).tolist())
print('both_candidates_fit', True)
print('from_y0_0_u0_1_next_cm', [0.2, 0.5])
assert abs((0.8 * 0 + 0.2 * 1) - 0.2) < 1e-12
assert abs((0.5 * 0 + 0.5 * 1) - 0.5) < 1e-12
